    - Objective = -sum(radii) + penalty * sum(constraint_violations^2)
    - Basinhopping combines local optimization with global random perturbations
    - Escapes local minima through temperature-based acceptance of worse solutions

            radii = np.clip(x[2*n:], 0.001, 0.5)
